aboutTitle: Great kingdoms are built on unity.
aboutBody: We believe the strongest kingdom is the one that stands together. From the first rally to the final siege, every warrior has a place, a voice, and a purpose.

faqBody: Your questions, answered before the next rally.
faqQ1: Can I apply from another kingdom?
faqA1: Yes. Apply first and discuss eligibility with our council. Migration depends on in-game rules and available windows; an application does not guarantee a transfer.
faqA2: Requirements vary by alliance and available space. Share your troop tier and power so the council can find the right fit.
faqA3: We plan together in Discord, assign rally roles, and coordinate across time zones. Final plans are shared with approved members.
faqQ4: What are the resource protection rules?
faqA4: Respect kingdom agreements and follow the current shield and gathering guidance from leadership. Ask the council for the latest rules.

oroAllianceDescription: Ouroboros symbolizes an eternal cycle—strength, renewal, and unity. It reflects how we continue to grow, rebuild, and come back stronger together no matter the challenge.
phxAllianceDescription: From the ashes, we are reborn! Burning in a blaze of glory, we rise to victory! Experienced leadership from multiple Kingdoms! Join now and learn from the best!
valAllianceDescription:
Valyria — Forged by Fire, Bound by Blood!

Empires may fall, but legends never die. Forged in fire and tempered by war, Valyria stands unbroken. United by strength, loyalty, and an unyielding will, we rise to face every challenge. We do not fear the flames — we are the fire. 🐉🔥

We have dragons, Warriors, tequila and questionable sleep schedules 😅
hydAllianceDescription: We are multi headed, we are mythological. We are the hydra and our members are the heads.
btcAllianceDescription:
BTC represents strength, loyalty, and unity. We’re a laid-back alliance that knows how to have fun but also knows how to fight and win. We believe real life always comes first, and nobody should feel like the game is a second job.

We fight hard, stand together, and celebrate our victories as a team. No unnecessary drama, no unrealistic expectations—just good people, strong teamwork, and a brotherhood that has each other’s backs.

Real life first. Brotherhood always. Victory.
